abstract: BACKGROUND: Malignant ovarian tumors in children are relatively rare. We reviewed our 15-year experience to understand their clinical presentations, managements, and prognoses. METHODS: There were 15 children who were diagnosed to have malignant ovarian tumors from January 1994 to June 2009 in our hospital. The presenting symptoms, treatments, and outcomes were obtained retrospectively from the medical records. RESULTS: The median age at presentation was 13 years. The most common presenting symptom was abdominal pain, occurring in 10 patients (66.7%). The tumors were in the left side in 10 patients (66.7%). The pathologic diagnoses were yolk sac tumors in four patients, immature teratomas in four, dysgerminomas in three, malignant mixed germ cell tumors in three, and carcinosarcoma in one patient. According to the Federation Internationale de Gynecologie Oncologique classification, seven girls had Stage I, one had Stage II, and seven had Stage III disease. Thirteen patients received chemotherapy with platinum-based regimens. Three patients died of their disease: one of yolk sac tumor, one of malignant mixed germ cell tumor, and one of carcinosarcoma. They all had Stage III disease at diagnosis. The 10-year overall survival and disease-free survival rates were 77% and 69%, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric malignant ovarian tumors were highly curable disease if they were not in the advanced stage at presentation. Earlier consideration of malignant ovarian tumor in the differential diagnosis of young girls with abdominal pain is important.
abstract_ja: 背景：小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍は比較的まれである。我々は15年間の経験を振り返り、臨床像、治療、予後を明らかにすることを目的とした。方法：1994年1月から2009年6月までに当院で悪性卵巣腫瘍と診断された15例の小児を対象とした。診断時の症状、治療、転帰は診療録から後方視的に取得した。結果：診断時の年齢中央値は13歳であった。最も多い症状は腹痛で、10例（66.7%）に認められた。腫瘍は10例（66.7%）で左側にあった。病理学的診断は、卵黄嚢腫瘍が4例、未熟奇形腫が4例、ディスジャーミノーマが3例、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍が3例、癌肉腫が1例であった。国際産科婦人科連合（FIGO）分類では、7例が病期I、1例が病期II、7例が病期IIIであった。13例が白金製剤併用化学療法を受けた。3例が原病により死亡した：卵黄嚢腫瘍、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍、癌肉腫が各1例。いずれも診断時に病期IIIであった。10年全生存率および無病生存率はそれぞれ77%、69%であった。結論：小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍は、進行期で発見されなければ治癒可能性の高い疾患である。腹痛を訴える若い女児の鑑別診断として悪性卵巣腫瘍を早期に考慮することが重要である。
